sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT bought_date_key, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
  FROM "datamart"."postcard_company_core"."fact_sales"
  GROUP BY bought_date_key
),
dated AS (
  SELECT d.date_value, daily.revenue
  FROM daily
  JOIN "datamart"."postcard_company_core"."dim_date" d
    ON d.date_key = daily.bought_date_key
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT MAX(date_value) AS last_sale FROM dated
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN dated.date_value >= make_date(YEAR(b.last_sale), 1, 1)
              AND dated.date_value <= b.last_sale
             THEN dated.revenue END) AS revenue_2026_ytd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN dated.date_value >= make_date(YEAR(b.last_sale) - 1, 1, 1)
              AND dated.date_value <= CAST(b.last_sale - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
             THEN dated.revenue END) AS revenue_2025_same_dates
  FROM dated
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
)
SELECT
  revenue_2026_ytd,
  revenue_2025_same_dates,
  ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_2026_ytd - revenue_2025_same_dates) / NULLIF(revenue_2025_same_dates, 0), 1) AS revenue_change_pct
FROM totals

JOIN "datamart"."postcard_company_core"."dim_customer" dc ON fs.customer_key = dc.customer_key
WHERE fs.commissionpct IS NULL
GROUP BY dc.customer_key, dc.original_customer_id, dc.customer_first_name, dc.customer_last_name
ORDER BY SUM(fs.total_amount) DESC
LIMIT 1
